info.name: HomeHelp - Steps 17-19 holds, bookings, rescheduling
info.description: Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner recommended): later requests depend on earlier ones. Setup approves a fresh provider, so start the API with HOMEHELP_ADMIN_EMAIL and HOMEHELP_ADMIN_PASSWORD matching the adminEmail and adminPassword variables. Each run uses its own random location, so earlier runs never interfere.

item.name: 0. Setup

exec: // A random spot in the Scottish Highlands, so each run has its own isolated area.
// Next Monday at least two days away.

item.description: Creates an approved provider and two customers (A and B) at a random spot, plus next Monday's date.

exec: const local = s => new Date(s).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Europe/London', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
pm.test('Five free times, 09:00 to 11:00', () => pm.expect(body.slots.map(s => local(s.start))).to.eql(['09:00', '09:30', '10:00', '10:30', '11:00']));
// Save each start time, e.g. slot0900, for the requests below.
pm.test('Ten-minute hold', () => { const mins = (new Date(body.expiresAt) - Date.now()) / 60000; pm.expect(mins).to.be.within(9, 10.1); });

Provider: cancel B with a reason

exec: pm.test('Cancelled, not late (days ahead)', () => { pm.expect(body.status).to.eql('CANCELLED'); pm.expect(body.cancellation.late).to.be.false; pm.expect(body.cancellation.reason).to.eql('Fixed it myself'); });
const local = s => new Date(s).toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', { timeZone: 'Europe/London', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
pm.test('CREATED, RESCHEDULED x2, CANCELLED', () => pm.expect(body.history.map(h => h.type)).to.eql(['CREATED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'RESCHEDULED', 'CANCELLED']));

item.description: Starting and completing a job, and late cancellations, depend on the real clock (within 30 minutes / 24 hours of the start), so they're covered by the automated tests rather than here.
